{{Quote|Routine inquiries. You have nothing to fear if you have done nothing wrong.|The stormtrooper leader|<ref name="WG" />}}
This  '''individual''' [[Human/Legends|Human]] served as [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="WG" /> 

In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], a squad of Imperial stormtroopers conducted a routine at the [[Azure Dianoga Cantina]], located in the [[Alien Protection Zone/Legends|Alien Protection Zone]] of Coruscant. The squad leader first approached a table occupied by two [[Quarren/Legends|Quarrens]] and a tall [[Unidentified Duros (Azure Dianoga)|Duros]]. He demanded [[Identichip/Legends|identification cards]] from all three patrons, scanned each card on his [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], and returned only the Duros's card. He instructed both Quarren to accompany the stormtroopers out of the cantina, assuring the pair that they have nothing to fear if they haven't done anything wrong.<ref name="WG" />

In reality, the stormtroopers were acting under orders from [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Kirtan Loor]], who directed Imperial forces to round up Quarrens in the undercity to serve as test subjects for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Evir Derricote]]'s experiment to create the [[Krytos virus]].<ref name="WG" />

The stormtrooper and his team then proceeded to inspect the other tables in the cantina, including one occupied by undercover members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], an elite [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit serving the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. He attempted to pressure the young [[Gavin Darklighter]] into leaving the establishment without Gavin's [[Alien/Legends|Alien]] companions, and openly expressed contempt towards [[Rhysati Ynr]] for maintaining a relationship with an alien partner. After scanning the identification cards of the Rogues and finding no issues, he and his team exited the cantina.<ref name="WG" />

==Equipment==
The squad leader was equipped with a datapad attached to the [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armor]] on his right thigh that he used to scan identification cards.<ref name="WG" />
